summary: The packaged build no longer kills makensis part-way through compressing the app.
details: electron-builder allows the piped makensis process four minutes, which assumes it only embeds a pre-built app.7z; ArcRho compresses the whole unpacked app inside makensis.
The build patcher now raises that kill timeout to 30 minutes.
A build that hit the old limit reported only 'Exit code: null' with empty compiler output, because the kill arrives as a signal rather than a compiler error.
